component.name: RAWM Control
component.summary: Configure RAWM gaming mice on Linux

description.p: RAWM Control is a native GTK4/libadwaita application for RAWM gaming mice. It talks directly to the mouse's vendor HID interface, so no browser, Windows VM or vendor service is needed.

ul.li: Battery percentage, charging state and connection type in the tray
Polling rate, motion sync, ripple control, angle snapping and tuning
Lift-off distance, power mode and sleep timer
DPI levels with per-level indicator colours

description.p: This project is not affiliated with RAWM or MiraclTek. It was built by reverse-engineering the public RAWM HUB web driver.
